title: 第11章 叶心夏第12章 雷之力雷印
slug: 全职法师第210章依旧强势
lines: 带着愉悦的心情，哼着小苹果，莫凡朝着铭文中学走去了。
铭文中学是一所女子中学，属于私立的中学，里面聚集着全夏城最水嫩、最时尚的少女们。
和别的中学有所不同，这里没有死气沉沉的魔法理论教育，更没有一群只知道考试的魔法书呆子，她们这群本身就存在着一些家庭魔法背景的少女们懂得的东西要远比九年义务魔法教育走出来的魔法学生们更多，比如说一些带有魔法力量的魔器配饰就常常挂在他们胸前。
和这群一出身就挂着可以温养精神力的魔器的魔二代、法二代，莫凡这种**丝自然得一步一步攀爬。
校园周围小道上都挤满了豪华轿车，正值放学高峰期，莫凡很清楚心夏的脾气，她会绕开这些攀比轿车级别的少女们，走那条属于她自己的胡同小道，闻着窗台边住户们自己种的小青竹的幽香……
莫凡绕开了正门，打算去胡同小道那里堵截……呃，静候这位邻家妹妹叶心夏。
胡同小道走的人不多，莫凡穿过了别人家的院子，步入到这个熟悉的小道胡同里。
世界变了，但这座熟悉的城市一点都没有改变，熬过了冬季的小青竹也还在住户的窗子边摆放着。
想来，叶心夏应该也没有变吧。
莫凡站在巷子中央，背靠着墙，宛如一个伺机敲诈路过的小学生游戏币的小流氓，眼睛时不时的看一眼胡同口，心里想着给即将往这里走的少女一个惊喜，谁知好半天那个倩丽的身影都没有出现。
怎么还不来啊？
莫凡这个pose都摆得有些酸了。
稍稍闭上眼睛，莫凡几乎一种习惯似的要进入冥修……
忽然，莫凡感觉到胡同口通往小山的方向上传出了一些嘈杂的声音，这些声音正常情况下是会被胡同的高墙给隔绝的，却不知为什么会传入到自己的耳朵里……
莫非冥修的附带效果是感知能力也变强了？？
带着这份好奇，莫凡朝着通往小山丘的方向走去。
一走出小胡同，面向小山的位置一下子豁然开朗，其实这座山的正对面大概有一公里的距离，山脚下就是自己那个刚卖掉不久的老屋。
山丘下有一座小小的草坪，草坪布置成小公园的模样，在靠近风口的位置有着一座缠绕着一些冬藤的木秋千。
秋千笔直的垂下，没有一丝丝的摇晃。
静止的秋千上坐着一个黑色瀑布长发的少女，冬季里的风正拨乱着她的发丝，露出了一张白皙饱满的精美侧脸，长长的睫毛、精巧的小鼻梁、玉润粉蜜的唇边……
她注视着前方，安静得就像融入到了这副冬季的秋千画卷里的一朵娇莲，凄凄楚楚却独自绽放着自己独特的气质与芬芳。
莫凡步伐突然就停住，也不知道什么时候自己就喜欢这样静静的看着她，看着她静静的坐在某个地方，心里会莫名的涌起一阵暖流，流淌到自己心底，然后不由自主的浮起嘴角。
不过，片刻，莫凡感觉到不对劲。
content_en:
…
With a happy mood and humming to Little Apple, Mo Fan walked towards Inscription Middle School.
Mingwen Middle School is a girls' middle school, a private middle school, where the most tender and fashionable girls in the entire Xia City gather.
Different from other middle schools, there is no lifeless magic theory education here, nor is there a group of magic nerds who only know about exams. These girls, who have some family magic background, know far more than the magic students who have come out of the nine-year compulsory magic education. For example, some magic weapons and accessories with magical power are often hung on their chests.
With this group of second-generation demons and second-generation magicians who have been equipped with magical weapons that can nourish their spiritual power since they were born, Mo Fan, who has such a charisma, naturally has to climb up step by step.
The alleys around the campus are crowded with luxury cars. It is the peak period after school. Mo Fan knows Xinxia's temper very well. She will avoid these girls who are competing for the level of cars and take her own alleyway, smelling the fragrance of the small green bamboos planted by the residents beside the windowsill...
Mo Fan bypassed the main entrance and planned to go to the alley to intercept... uh, wait for the neighbor sister Ye Xinxia.
There were not many people walking along the alley. Mo Fan passed through someone else's yard and walked into this familiar alley.
The world has changed, but this familiar city has not changed at all. The small green bamboos that have survived the winter are still placed by the windows of residents.
Come to think of it, Ye Xinxia probably hasn't changed either.
…
Mo Fan stood in the middle of the alley, with his back against the wall, like a hooligan who was waiting for an opportunity to extort game coins from the passing elementary school students. He glanced at the entrance of the alley from time to time, thinking of giving a surprise to the girl who was about to go here, but to his surprise, the beautiful figure did not appear for a long time.
Why haven't you come yet?
Mo Fan's pose was a bit sour.
Closing his eyes for a moment, Mo Fan almost entered into meditation as a habit...
Suddenly, Mo Fan felt some noisy sounds coming from the direction of the alley leading to the hill. Normally, these sounds would be isolated by the high walls of the alley, but for some reason they reached his ears...
Could it be that a side effect of meditation is that the ability to perceive has become stronger? ?
With this curiosity, Mo Fan walked towards the direction of the hill.
As soon as I walked out of the small alley, the location facing the hill suddenly became clear. In fact, the mountain was about a kilometer away directly opposite. At the foot of the hill was my old house that I had just sold.
There is a small lawn at the foot of the hill. The lawn is arranged like a small park. There is a wooden swing wrapped with some winter vines near the wind outlet.
The swing hangs straight down without any sway.
Sitting on the stationary swing was a girl with long black hair. The wind in winter was ruffling her hair, revealing a fair, plump and beautiful side face, with long eyelashes, a delicate bridge of nose, and pink lips...
She stared ahead, as quiet as a delicate lotus integrated into this winter swing picture, desolate but blooming alone with its own unique temperament and fragrance.
Mo Fan's steps suddenly stopped, and he didn't know when he liked to look at her quietly like this. Watching her sitting quietly somewhere, an inexplicable warm current surged in his heart, flowing to the bottom of his heart, and then the corners of his mouth raised involuntarily.
However, for a moment, Mo Fan felt something was wrong.
